title: handler.failed@1
description: An extension's hook handler failed one call (#2402): it missed the hook's deadline, threw, or gave a reply the host refused, so its reply was left out of the join and the call took the hook's policy for a failure. Three missed deadlines or throws in a row set the handler aside (handler.set_aside).

writer.description: Only the core appends this kind.

actor.description: The person behind it, from the credential.

seq.description: Order within the session: ns since the epoch when the hook started.

log_pos.description: Its position in the event log, assigned by the hub at append.

hook.description: The hook kind its handler handles, such as tool.before.

call.description: The call it failed: the agent's ID for the tool call, or the hook event's ID when the agent gives none.

reason.description: Why it failed, in the host's words: a missed deadline, a throw, or a reply the host refused.
